description: Enterprise deterministic technical support troubleshooting agent for Rogers Communications

configSource.inlineText:
agent: RogersResidentialTroubleshooting
description: "Enterprise deterministic technical support troubleshooting agent for Rogers Communications"

metadata:
  persona: "You are Rogers' Residential Technical Support virtual assistant — confident, efficient, and direct. You speak naturally for telephony and chat: short turns, plain language, and one clear question at a time. Never apologize; replace sympathy with action ('Let me take a look at things on our end')."
  global_rules: "Strictly adhere to the deterministic troubleshooting decision tree. Never answer out-of-scope trivia, creative writing, or general knowledge. Maintain customer authentication context across turns."

enums:
  ModemLightState: enum<SOLID, FLASHING, OFF>
  ModemLightColor: enum<GREEN, YELLOW, WHITE, AMBER_GREEN, NONE>
  DeviceScope: enum<ALL_DEVICES, SINGLE_DEVICE>
  SpeedTestResult: enum<ABOVE_90, BELOW_90>
  WifiSignalLabel: enum<POOR_OR_WEAK, STRONG>
  TvSymptom: enum<ERROR_CODE, BLACK_SCREEN, REMOTE_UNRESPONSIVE>
  AppointmentWindow: enum<MORNING, AFTERNOON>

objects:
  CustomerAuth:
    account_number:
      type: string
      regex: '^\d{9}$'
      visibility: user
      hint: "Could you please provide your 9-digit Rogers account number?"
    pin:
      type: string
      regex: '^\d{4}$'
      visibility: user
      hint: "What is your 4-digit security PIN?"

  NoConnectionDiagnostics:
    has_outage:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal
    outage_id:
      type: string
      visibility: internal
    device_scope:
      type: DeviceScope
      visibility: user
      hint: "Are all devices in your home offline (ALL_DEVICES), or is only a single device affected (SINGLE_DEVICE)?"
    modem_light_state:
      type: ModemLightState
      visibility: user
      hint: "Is the light on the front of your Rogers modem solid (SOLID), flashing (FLASHING), or completely off (OFF)?"
    modem_light_color:
      type: ModemLightColor
      visibility: user
      hint: "What color is the light on your modem: GREEN, YELLOW, WHITE, or alternating amber and green (AMBER_GREEN)?"
    outlet_checked:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Have you verified the power cable is firmly plugged in and tested a different wall outlet?"
    coax_checked:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Is the screw-on coaxial cable finger-tight at both the modem backplate and wall outlet?"
    reboot_completed:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Has the modem power cycle finished and the light turned solid white (answer true only after the reboot is fully completed, not when you are about to start)?"
    app_pause_checked:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "In the Rogers Xfinity app, have you confirmed this device is not currently paused?"
    wifi_reconnected:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Did forgetting the WiFi network and reconnecting restore access on this device?"
    escalated:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal
    is_resolved:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal

  SlowSpeedDiagnostics:
    speed_test_result:
      type: SpeedTestResult
      visibility: user
      hint: "In the Rogers Xfinity app network test, is the speed test result ABOVE_90 or BELOW_90 percent of your plan speed?"
    line_status:
      type: string
      visibility: internal
    packet_loss_pct:
      type: number
      visibility: internal
    device_wifi_label:
      type: WifiSignalLabel
      visibility: user
      hint: "In the app device list, does the affected device show a POOR_OR_WEAK or STRONG WiFi signal label?"
    modem_relocation_possible:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Is it possible to move your gateway to a more central coaxial outlet in your home?"
    line_reboot_done:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Has the modem completely finished power cycling and returned online (answer true only after the reboot is fully completed, not when you are about to start)?"
    is_resolved:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal

  TvDiagnostics:
    symptom:
      type: TvSymptom
      visibility: user
      hint: "What issue are you experiencing with your TV (ERROR_CODE, BLACK_SCREEN, or REMOTE_UNRESPONSIVE)?"
    error_code:
      type: string
      visibility: user
      hint: "What is the error code on your TV screen (e.g. XRE-03007 or RDK-03033)?"
    refresh_successful:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal
    hdmi_input_checked:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Did verifying the TV is set to the correct HDMI input display the picture?"
    remote_paired:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Did holding Rogers and Info until the light turned green pair your remote?"
    box_restarted:
      type: bool
      visibility: user
      hint: "Has the TV box finished power cycling for 15 seconds and restored the picture (answer true only after completion, not when you are about to start)?"
    is_resolved:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal

  EscalationRequest:
    preferred_time:
      type: AppointmentWindow
      visibility: user
      hint: "What technician appointment window do you prefer: MORNING (8am-12pm) or AFTERNOON (12pm-4pm)?"
    ticket_id:
      type: string
      visibility: internal
    appointment_booked:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal
    is_resolved:
      type: bool
      visibility: internal

journeys:
  AuthenticateCustomer:
    trigger_intent: "The user wants to authenticate, log in, or provide their account credentials."
    goal: "Verify account credentials with 9-digit account number and 4-digit PIN."
    params:
      auth: CustomerAuth
    complete_when: "auth.account_number is set && auth.pin is set"
    body:
      - do: builtin ask(auth.account_number, "Welcome to Rogers Residential Technical Support! Let me take a look at things on our end. Could you please provide your 9-digit account number?")
        when: "auth.account_number is unset"

      - do: builtin ask(auth.pin, "Thank you. What is your 4-digit security PIN?")
        when: "auth.account_number is set && auth.pin is unset"

  NoInternetConnection:
    trigger_intent: "The user reports no internet connection, total loss of service, modem offline, or device unable to connect."
    goal: "Deterministically diagnose and restore internet connectivity following the Rogers No Connection protocol."
    params:
      auth: CustomerAuth
      diag: NoConnectionDiagnostics
    complete_when: "diag.is_resolved == true"
    body:
      # Step 0: Auth Verification
      - do: builtin ask(auth.account_number, "Welcome to Rogers Technical Support! Let me check your account. Could you please provide your 9-digit account number?")
        when: "auth.account_number is unset"

      - do: builtin ask(auth.pin, "Thank you. What is your 4-digit security PIN?")
        when: "auth.account_number is set && auth.pin is unset"

      # Step 0b: Automated Area Outage Pre-Check
      - do: tool CheckAreaOutage(auth, diag)
        when: "auth.pin is set && diag.has_outage is unset"

      # Step 0c: Outage Detected Early Exit
      - do:
          - say: "Our systems detect an active network outage in your area (Outage Reference #{diag.outage_id}). Our field technicians are currently working on restoration."
          - update: diag.is_resolved = true
        when: "diag.has_outage == true && diag.is_resolved != true"

      # Step 1: Multi-Device Isolation (if no area outage)
      - do: builtin ask(diag.device_scope, "Let's isolate the connection issue. Are all devices in your home offline, or is only a single device unable to connect?")
        when: "diag.has_outage == false && diag.device_scope is unset"

      # Step 2: Modem Light State Check (Solid, Flashing, or Off)
      - do: builtin ask(diag.modem_light_state, "Let's check your Rogers gateway. Is the light on the front of your modem solid, flashing, or completely off?")
        when: "diag.device_scope == 'ALL_DEVICES' && diag.modem_light_state is unset"

      # Step 2b: If completely off -> Outlet Check
      - do: builtin ask(diag.outlet_checked, "Please ensure the power cable is firmly seated in the back of the modem and the wall outlet. Have you tried plugging it into a different working outlet?")
        when: "diag.modem_light_state == 'OFF' && diag.outlet_checked is unset"

      # Step 2c: Hardware Failure -> Escalate
      - do:
          - say: "Since the gateway still will not power on after checking the outlet, your modem requires replacement. I am connecting you with a specialist to arrange an equipment swap."
          - update: diag.escalated = true
          - update: diag.is_resolved = true
        when: "diag.modem_light_state == 'OFF' && diag.outlet_checked == true && diag.escalated != true"

      # Step 3: If lights are on (Solid or Flashing), ask for exact color
      - do: builtin ask(diag.modem_light_color, "What color is the light on your modem? (e.g. green, yellow, white, or alternating amber and green)")
        when: "diag.modem_light_state != 'OFF' && diag.modem_light_state is set && diag.modem_light_color is unset"

      # Step 3a: Solid White -> Connected (Only if no reboot is pending/in-progress)
      - do:
          - say: "A solid white light indicates your gateway is online and connected to the Rogers network."
          - update: diag.is_resolved = true
        when: "diag.modem_light_state == 'SOLID' && diag.modem_light_color == 'WHITE' && diag.coax_checked is unset && diag.reboot_completed is unset && diag.is_resolved != true"

      # Step 3b: Firmware Update (Alternating Amber / Green)
      - do:
          - say: "An alternating amber and green light indicates a routine firmware update is in progress. Please wait about 10 minutes for your gateway to reboot automatically."
          - update: diag.is_resolved = true
        when: "diag.modem_light_color == 'AMBER_GREEN' && diag.is_resolved != true"

      # Step 3c: Signal Issue -> Coax Cable Check (Flashing Green or Flashing Yellow)
      - do: builtin ask(diag.coax_checked, "A flashing light indicates a signal connection issue. Please check the coaxial cable on the back of the modem and at the wall. Is it finger-tight at both ends?")
        when: "diag.modem_light_state == 'FLASHING' && (diag.modem_light_color == 'GREEN' || diag.modem_light_color == 'YELLOW') && diag.coax_checked is unset"

      # Step 3d: Coax Checked -> Reboot Gateway
      - do: builtin ask(diag.reboot_completed, "Let's power cycle the modem. Please unplug the power cable from the back of the modem, wait 30 seconds, plug it back in, and let me know when the light turns solid white.")
        when: "diag.coax_checked == true && diag.reboot_completed is unset"

      # Step 3e: Restored After Reboot
      - do:
          - say: "Great, your Rogers gateway is back online with a solid white light. Your connection is restored!"
          - update: diag.is_resolved = true
        when: "diag.reboot_completed == true && diag.is_resolved != true"

      # Step 4: Single Device Isolation (App Pause Check)
      - do: builtin ask(diag.app_pause_checked, "Since other devices are working, please open the Rogers Xfinity app to verify this specific device has not been paused in household profiles. Is it unpaused?")
        when: "diag.device_scope == 'SINGLE_DEVICE' && diag.app_pause_checked is unset"

      # Step 4b: WiFi Network Reconnection
      - do: builtin ask(diag.wifi_reconnected, "Let's forget the WiFi network on that device, toggle WiFi off and on, and reconnect. Did that restore your connection?")
        when: "diag.device_scope == 'SINGLE_DEVICE' && diag.app_pause_checked == true && diag.wifi_reconnected is unset"

      # Step 4c: Single Device Resolved
      - do:
          - say: "Excellent, your device is successfully reconnected to your Rogers home WiFi."
          - update: diag.is_resolved = true
        when: "diag.device_scope == 'SINGLE_DEVICE' && diag.wifi_reconnected == true && diag.is_resolved != true"

  SlowAndIntermittentInternet:
    trigger_intent: "The user reports slow speeds, buffering, dropping WiFi, or poor wireless coverage."
    goal: "Diagnose and resolve internet speed and WiFi coverage degradation."
    params:
      auth: CustomerAuth
      slow: SlowSpeedDiagnostics
    complete_when: "slow.is_resolved == true"
    body:
      # Step 0: Auth Verification
      - do: builtin ask(auth.account_number, "Welcome to Rogers Technical Support! Let me check your account. Could you please provide your 9-digit account number?")
        when: "auth.account_number is unset"

      - do: builtin ask(auth.pin, "Thank you. What is your 4-digit security PIN?")
        when: "auth.account_number is set && auth.pin is unset"

      # Step 1: App Speed Test
      - do: builtin ask(slow.speed_test_result, "Let's test the connection coming into your home. In the Rogers Xfinity app under WiFi, please run 'Test Your Home Network'. Is the result above 90% or below 90% of your plan speed?")
        when: "auth.pin is set && slow.speed_test_result is unset"

      # Step 2: Signal / Range Check (if speed >= 90%)
      - do: builtin ask(slow.device_wifi_label, "Your gateway is receiving full speed from the network. In the app device list, does the slow device show a Poor or Weak WiFi signal label?")
        when: "slow.speed_test_result == 'ABOVE_90' && slow.device_wifi_label is unset"

      # Step 2b: Placement & Relocation
      - do: builtin ask(slow.modem_relocation_possible, "Weak signal indicates range interference. Is your gateway placed centrally in your home, and can you move it to a more central coax outlet?")
        when: "slow.device_wifi_label == 'POOR_OR_WEAK' && slow.modem_relocation_possible is unset"

      # Step 2c: Boost Pod Recommendation & Representative Transfer
      - do:
          - say: "Since relocating the gateway isn't an option, Rogers Xfinity WiFi Boost Pods are recommended to eliminate dead zones. I am connecting you with a representative now to assist with adding Pods to your account."
          - update: slow.is_resolved = true
        when: "slow.modem_relocation_possible == false && slow.is_resolved != true"

      # Step 3: Line Issue (< 90%) -> Remote Diagnostics Tool
      - do: tool RunLineDiagnostics(auth, slow)
        when: "slow.speed_test_result == 'BELOW_90' && slow.line_status is unset"

      # Step 3b: Power Cycle to clear line congestion
      - do: builtin ask(slow.line_reboot_done, "Line diagnostics indicate packet congestion on your node. Let's reboot the modem for 30 seconds to clear line noise. Please let me know once it is back online.")
        when: "slow.line_status is set && slow.line_reboot_done is unset"

      # Step 3c: Speed Restored
      - do:
          - say: "Your line speed has been refreshed and optimized. Your connection is back to peak performance."
          - update: slow.is_resolved = true
        when: "slow.line_reboot_done == true && slow.is_resolved != true"

  TVSupport:
    trigger_intent: "The user reports TV box issues, black screen, error codes like XRE-03007 or RDK-03033, or remote control problems."
    goal: "Diagnose Rogers TV set-top box, video feed, remote control, and error code faults."
    params:
      auth: CustomerAuth
      tv: TvDiagnostics
    complete_when: "tv.is_resolved == true"
    body:
      # Step 0: Auth Verification
      - do: builtin ask(auth.account_number, "Welcome to Rogers Technical Support! Let me check your account. Could you please provide your 9-digit account number?")
        when: "auth.account_number is unset"

      - do: builtin ask(auth.pin, "Thank you. What is your 4-digit security PIN?")
        when: "auth.account_number is set && auth.pin is unset"

      # Step 1: Symptom Classification
      - do: builtin ask(tv.symptom, "What issue are you experiencing with your Rogers TV? (e.g. error code on screen, black screen, or unresponsive remote)")
        when: "auth.pin is set && tv.symptom is unset"

      # Step 2: Error Code Lookup
      - do: builtin ask(tv.error_code, "What is the exact error code showing on your TV screen (e.g. XRE-03007 or RDK-03033)?")
        when: "tv.symptom == 'ERROR_CODE' && tv.error_code is unset"

      # Step 2b: XRE Error (Automated Refresh Tool)
      - do: tool SendTvRefreshSignal(auth, tv)
        when: "tv.error_code == 'XRE-03007' && tv.refresh_successful is unset"

      # Step 2c: XRE Refreshed
      - do:
          - say: "An XRE-03007 code indicates channel entitlements need syncing. I have sent an automated refresh signal to your TV box and refreshed your channels. Please allow 2 minutes for the guide to reload."
          - update: tv.is_resolved = true
        when: "tv.refresh_successful == true && tv.is_resolved != true"

      # Step 2d: RDK Error (Network Loss)
      - do: builtin ask(tv.box_restarted, "An RDK error means the TV box lost communication with the gateway. Please unplug the TV box power cord for 15 seconds and plug it back in. Did that bring the picture back?")
        when: "tv.error_code == 'RDK-03033' && tv.box_restarted is unset"

      # Step 3: Black Screen -> HDMI Input
      - do: builtin ask(tv.hdmi_input_checked, "Please ensure the TV box power light is illuminated. On your TV remote, press Source/Input and confirm you are on the correct HDMI port. Did the picture appear?")
        when: "tv.symptom == 'BLACK_SCREEN' && tv.hdmi_input_checked is unset"

      # Step 4: Remote Control Pairing
      - do: builtin ask(tv.remote_paired, "Let's re-pair your voice remote. Press and hold the Rogers and Info buttons until the light flashes green, then press 9-9-1. Is your remote responding now?")
        when: "tv.symptom == 'REMOTE_UNRESPONSIVE' && tv.remote_paired is unset"

      # Step 5: TV Resolved
      - do:
          - say: "Great! Your Rogers TV service is now working properly."
          - update: tv.is_resolved = true
        when: "tv.is_resolved != true && (tv.hdmi_input_checked == true || tv.remote_paired == true || tv.box_restarted == true)"

  TechnicianAndEscalation:
    trigger_intent: "The user specifically requests a technician visit, asks for an on-site technician to come to their house, or needs physical on-site equipment inspection."
    goal: "Schedule a field technician dispatch or initiate specialist escalation."
    params:
      auth: CustomerAuth
      esc: EscalationRequest
    complete_when: "esc.is_resolved == true"
    body:
      # Step 0: Auth Verification
      - do: builtin ask(auth.account_number, "Welcome to Rogers Technical Support! Let me check your account. Could you please provide your 9-digit account number?")
        when: "auth.account_number is unset"

      - do: builtin ask(auth.pin, "Thank you. What is your 4-digit security PIN?")
        when: "auth.account_number is set && auth.pin is unset"

      - do: 'builtin ask(esc.preferred_time, "I can arrange a Rogers field technician visit to inspect your equipment. What time window works best for you: morning (8am-12pm) or afternoon (12pm-4pm)?")'
        when: "auth.pin is set && esc.preferred_time is unset"

      - do: tool BookTechnicianAppointment(auth, esc)
        when: "esc.preferred_time is set && esc.appointment_booked is unset"

      - do:
          - say: "Your technician appointment has been scheduled for your requested window. Confirmation ticket #{esc.ticket_id} has been dispatched to your account."
          - update: esc.is_resolved = true
        when: "esc.appointment_booked == true && esc.is_resolved != true"

tools:
  CheckAreaOutage:
    params: { auth: CustomerAuth, diag: NoConnectionDiagnostics }
    inputs:
      account_number: auth.account_number
    outputs:
      - diag.has_outage = result.has_outage
      - diag.outage_id = result.outage_id
    external_tool: check_outage
    reversible: false

  RunLineDiagnostics:
    params: { auth: CustomerAuth, slow: SlowSpeedDiagnostics }
    inputs:
      account_number: auth.account_number
    outputs:
      - slow.line_status = result.line_status
      - slow.packet_loss_pct = result.packet_loss_pct
    external_tool: run_line_diagnostics
    reversible: false

  SendTvRefreshSignal:
    params: { auth: CustomerAuth, tv: TvDiagnostics }
    inputs:
      account_number: auth.account_number
      error_code: tv.error_code
    outputs:
      - tv.refresh_successful = result.refresh_successful
    external_tool: send_tv_refresh_signal
    reversible: false

  BookTechnicianAppointment:
    params: { auth: CustomerAuth, esc: EscalationRequest }
    inputs:
      account_number: auth.account_number
      time_slot: esc.preferred_time
    outputs:
      - esc.ticket_id = result.ticket_id
      - esc.appointment_booked = result.appointment_booked
    external_tool: book_technician_appointment
    reversible: false
